title: A procedure validates the container's pinned digest and checksums against their official sources, at build and at every start
goal: One stdlib python script, run on the host at image build and by the launcher at every container start, fails closed: it compares the Dockerfile's pinned base image digest with the registry's manifest digest, the pinned claude CLI version's npm integrity hash with the registry's, and the pinned sops and age releases' checksums with the checksum files their projects publish (signatures too where a project publishes them); an unreachable source, a missing pin or any mismatch stops the start with a named reason; it prints each pin, its source and the result, and never pastes a pin from a page. Planted failures: a changed digest, a changed hash, an unreachable source, a missing pin. It proves the artifact was not altered after the pin was taken; which base image to trust stays the operator's one decision.
